registration.geometry: 36 bracketed bisection steps with implicit gradient; same warp functions and physical bounds.
registration.reason: Six damped radius iterations failed the .05 whitened-RMS accuracy check in four objects. Twenty iterations remained inadequate in two.
registration.starts: Warp refits from previous warp and rotation; full refits from previous full, nested rotation and asymmetric model. Same training pixels only.
registration.unchanged: Source brightness, covariance, physical parameter limits and balanced radial selection. Nonwarp models are algebraically unchanged.
registration.limitations: A precise radius root does not certify unique 3D structure. A nonmonotonic ring-mapping scan flags possible folds.
registration.selection: Converged minimum training objective; no test-spectrum selection.
